boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten map-listed destinations along practical corridors near CSUB, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Stockdale Highway: Grocery Reset
cards.subtitle: Stockdale Highway corridor
cards.notes: Head east on Stockdale Highway for everyday groceries, fresh produce, bakery items, flowers, and Trader Joe's-label foods.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Stockdale Highway stop for groceries and household food basics.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe's operates its Bakersfield store at 8200 Stockdale Highway and lists produce, bakery items, flowers, and everyday groceries.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; confirm holiday changes before leaving.

cards.title: Ming Avenue: Big-Screen Break
cards.subtitle: Ming Avenue corridor at The Marketplace
cards.notes: Follow Ming Avenue to catch a current movie in an identifiable theater with recliner and stadium-seating options.
cards.short_summary: A Ming Avenue destination for a scheduled movie away from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Regal's official theater page places Regal Edwards Bakersfield at 9000-G Ming Avenue and lists movie showtimes and seating formats.
cards.source_title: Regal Edwards Bakersfield Movie Tickets and Showtimes | Regal
cards.access_notes: Showtimes vary by date and film; check the official theater page before traveling.

cards.title: California Avenue: Browse Books
cards.subtitle: California Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take California Avenue to browse books, vinyl, toys, and games, or check the store page for an upcoming author or reading event.
cards.short_summary: A bookshop stop with a café and a location-specific events listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Barnes & Noble's Bakersfield page identifies its 4001 California Avenue store and lists a café, vinyl, toys and games, and store events.
cards.source_title: Barnes & Noble Bookstore in Bakersfield, CA
cards.access_notes: Consult the official store page for current hours and event dates before visiting.

cards.title: Stockdale Highway: Supply Run
cards.subtitle: Stockdale Highway corridor at Buena Vista Road
cards.notes: Continue west on Stockdale Highway for a single-stop run when your list spans general merchandise, groceries, or personal essentials.
cards.short_summary: A west-corridor department store suited to a multi-category supply run.
cards.evidence_claim: Target's official Bakersfield locator identifies the Bakersfield West store at 11000 Stockdale Highway.
cards.source_title: Stores Near Me: Target — Bakersfield, California
cards.access_notes: Use Target's locator to open the Bakersfield West store details and confirm current hours and services.

cards.title: Gosford Road: One-Trip Restock
cards.subtitle: Gosford Road corridor near Harris Road
cards.notes: Go south on Gosford Road when you need groceries, clothing, electronics, or household goods consolidated into one errand.
cards.short_summary: A broad-selection supercenter for combining several practical errands.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart's official page locates Supercenter #5134 at 5075 Gosford Road and lists groceries, electronics, clothing, and other departments.
cards.source_title: Walmart Supercenter in Bakersfield, CA | Store 5134
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; individual departments may keep different hours.

cards.title: Stockdale Highway: Produce Stop
cards.subtitle: Stockdale Highway corridor west of campus
cards.notes: Travel west on Stockdale Highway when fresh produce and natural-food groceries are the central reason for the trip.
cards.short_summary: A produce-centered grocery destination on the west Stockdale corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Sprouts' official locator lists Bakersfield Store #280 at 10650 Stockdale Highway and describes its offering as groceries centered on fresh food.
cards.source_title: Sprouts Farmers Market | Bakersfield Store Location
cards.access_notes: Check the official store locator for current operating hours before making the trip.

cards.title: Ming Avenue: Project Supplies
cards.subtitle: Ming Avenue corridor east of The Marketplace
cards.notes: Use Ming Avenue for tools, project materials, plants, or equipment rentals when a repair or hands-on build needs supplies.
cards.short_summary: A hardware and garden stop with rental services for practical projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Home Depot's official page places Bakersfield Central #1050 at 4001 Ming Avenue and lists a Garden Center and Rental Center.
cards.source_title: Home Depot Bakersfield Central Store — Bakersfield, CA 93309
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday 6 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; service desks may differ.

cards.title: Stockdale Highway: Lakeside Loop
cards.subtitle: Stockdale Highway corridor between Calloway and Jewetta
cards.notes: Turn from Stockdale Highway toward the park to walk around two lakes or pair the grounds with a nearby Parkway-path outing.
cards.short_summary: A named river-corridor park with lakes, a walking trail, and an amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kern River Parkway Foundation says The Park at River Walk lies between Calloway Drive and Jewetta Avenue and contains two lakes, a walking trail, and an amphitheater.
cards.source_title: Parks and Open Space in the Parkway | Kern River Parkway Foundation
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and event restrictions can change; consult City recreation information before a planned gathering.

cards.title: Jewetta Avenue: Ballpark View
cards.subtitle: Jewetta Avenue corridor at Stockdale Highway
cards.notes: Stop at Jewetta Avenue and Stockdale Highway to see an 11-field baseball complex linked by bridges to The Park at River Walk.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable baseball complex connected to the River Walk park system.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kern River Parkway Foundation identifies Aera Park at Jewetta Avenue and Stockdale Highway as a 14-acre complex with 11 lighted fields and two bridges to The Park at River Walk.
cards.source_title: Parks and Open Space in the Parkway | Kern River Parkway Foundation
cards.access_notes: Field use may depend on scheduled leagues or events; verify availability before planning active recreation.

cards.title: Ming Avenue: Pizza Meetup
cards.subtitle: Ming Avenue corridor at The Marketplace
cards.notes: Meet on Ming Avenue for pizza when the plan calls for an all-ages restaurant with a clearly documented Marketplace address.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward group-meal destination on the Ming Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Mountain Mike's official location page identifies its Bakersfield–Ming restaurant at 9000 Ming Avenue.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery & Takeout — Bakersfield, CA | Mountain Mike's Pizza — Ming
cards.access_notes: Check the official location page for current dining, takeout, delivery, and operating-hour details.
